points: \item Designed and implemented AI-powered clinical criteria evaluation systems, translating complex medical policies into executable Python and SQL logic.
\item Engineered robust feature extraction pipelines to process messy clinical data, handling unit normalization and conflicting values to ensure high data integrity.
\item Developed comprehensive measurement and evaluation frameworks for LLM-based systems, defining accuracy metrics and continuous quality improvement loops.
\item Orchestrated regression testing and validation suites for policy-to-code translation, ensuring reliability and auditability of automated healthcare decisions.
\item Collaborated with clinicians and domain experts to refine prompt engineering strategies, optimizing the extraction of structured clinical signals from medical records.
\item Built and maintained monitoring dashboards to track system performance and data provenance, facilitating rapid debugging and iterative system enhancements.
